# @moku-labs/ai

> A build system for AI-generated assets — declarative build files in, artifacts out. Any task × any provider × any account pool. Resumable always, incremental by default, never loses a byte of progress. Built on @moku-labs/core (Layer 2 of the three-layer Moku model). Package manager: bun exclusively. Node >= 24, Bun >= 1.3.14.

## Core Concepts

### Three-layer plugin architecture
- Layer 1 (`src/config.ts`): `createCoreConfig("ai", ...)` registers the core plugins
  `logPlugin` + `envPlugin` (from @moku-labs/common) + `journalPlugin` + `storePlugin` +
  `limitsPlugin`. Exports the framework-scoped `createPlugin` and `createCore`.
  Global `Config` and `Events` are both empty by ratified decision — all configuration
  is per-plugin; the runner declares its own events.
- Layer 2 (`src/index.ts`): `createCore(coreConfig, { plugins: [...] })` assembles the
  10 regular plugins in dependency order and exports the public surface.
- Layer 3 (consumer apps): `import { createApp, createPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai"`.
  `createApp({ plugins?, pluginConfigs?, onReady?, ... })` → `await app.start()`.

### Core plugin APIs injected on every regular plugin's ctx
- `ctx.journal` — durable SQLite WAL ledger (also the atomic budget+dedup gate).
- `ctx.store` — content-addressed artifact store (CAS, sha256).
- `ctx.limits` — per-lane token bucket + concurrency gate + circuit breaker.
- `ctx.log` / `ctx.env` — structured logging / validated env (from @moku-labs/common).
Core APIs also mount on the app (`app.limits`, ...). Regular plugin APIs mount by name:
`app.runner`, `app.buildfile`, `app.voiceover`, `app.cli`, etc. (NOT `app.plugins.x`).

IMPORTANT: `createApp`'s `pluginConfigs` is typed to REGULAR plugins only. Core-plugin
config (journal/store/limits) is a `createCore`-level option — fixed by the framework
for Layer-3 consumers at M0 (`.moku/journal.db`, `.moku/store`, 60 rpm / 4 concurrent).

### Durability model (journal + store)
- One `runs` row per invocation; one `items` row per asset; one `attempts` row per
  provider call. Item state machine: queued → dispatching → done | failed | flagged.
- Every write is a committed transaction under `journal_mode=WAL`, `synchronous=FULL`,
  `fullfsync=1`, inside `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`. Guarantee: spend ≤ done + dispatching-at-kill.
- The journal stores METADATA ONLY (statuses/costs/hashes/error classes). Raw bytes go
  to the store: tmp file → fsync(file) → rename → fsync(dir); objects keyed by sha256 at
  `{dir}/{hash[0..2]}/{hash}`; reads recompute the hash and refuse corrupt bytes.
- Resume: `requeueDispatching` re-queues mid-flight items; `insertItems` is idempotent
  per (runId, planningKey), so done items are never re-billed.

### Runs, items, planning keys
- Planning key = sha256(canonicalJson({ task, input, params })) — provider deliberately
  excluded, key-order-independent. Artifact key = sha256(canonicalJson({ planningKey,
  provider, packVersion })).
- The atomic gate (`journal.gateToDispatching`) verifies still-queued + projected spend
  within `maxCostUsd` + transitions to dispatching, in ONE transaction.

### Lanes and admission control
- Lane = "{task}/{provider}/{account}"; account is always "default" at M0.
- Each lane: token bucket (rpm), FIFO concurrency gate, circuit breaker (opens after
  breakerThreshold consecutive retryable failures; half-open probe after cooldown).
- Lane config precedence: exact lane override → "{task}/{provider}" prefix → defaults.

### Task × provider decoupling (registry)
- `registry` is a dumb two-level map: task → provider → handler (stored as `unknown`).
- Provider plugins register handlers in `onInit` via `ctx.require(registryPlugin)`.
- Task plugins (voiceover/translate/promptGen) own their contract types and perform the
  ONE audited cast per task at their resolve() site. First-registered provider = task
  default. Registry must NEVER become a core plugin (core ctx has no require/depends).

### Retry taxonomy (contractual, runner-owned)
- Retry with jittered exponential backoff: http-5xx, http-429 (Retry-After honored when
  larger), timeout, network. Terminal `failed`: other http-4xx. Terminal `flagged`
  (never re-queued): content-policy.
- Providers steer classification by throwing Errors with structural hint fields
  (`status?`, `kind?: "timeout"|"network"|"content-policy"`, `retryAfterMs?`).
- Caller aborts are a clean pause, never classified or breaker-penalized.

### Event model
- Bus events: ONLY the runner declares any (5 run:* events). Subscribe from a plugin
  with `depends: [runnerPlugin]` and a `hooks` map (there is NO `app.on`).
- Per-item detail NEVER touches the bus — it flows through `app.runner.events()`, a
  backpressured AsyncIterable (bounded buffer, overflow coalescing, terminal always
  delivered last).

## Quick Reference

```ts
import { createApp, createPlugin, defineBuild, registryPlugin } from "@moku-labs/ai";
import type { Voiceover, Translate, PromptGen, Buildfile, Cli } from "@moku-labs/ai";

const app = createApp({
  pluginConfigs: { runner: { maxAttempts: 5 }, voiceover: { defaultProvider: "openai" } }
});
await app.start();

// Durable path (journaled, budget-gated, resumable)
const est = await app.runner.estimate({ files: "**/*.moku.yaml" });        // { lines, totalUsd }
const res = await app.runner.run({ files: "**/*.moku.yaml", maxCostUsd: 5 }); // { runId, status, totals }
await app.runner.resume({ runId: res.runId });                              // continues a paused run
app.runner.status();                                                        // { runId, status, totals, updatedAt }
for await (const e of app.runner.events()) { /* item:* stream records */ }

// One-off facades (NOT journaled)
await app.voiceover.generate({ text: "Hi", voice: "en-US-1" }, { provider: "elevenlabs" });
app.voiceover.estimate({ text: "Hi", voice: "en-US-1" });                   // { usd }
await app.translate.generate({ text: "Hi", targetLang: "es" });
await app.promptGen.generate({ prompt: "Write a tagline." });

// Build files
const { spec } = await app.buildfile.compile({ path: "build.moku.yaml" });
await app.buildfile.loadGlob("builds/**/*.moku.yaml");                      // CompiledBuild[]
app.buildfile.jsonSchema(); app.buildfile.template({ name: "demo" });

// NL → build file (LLM repair loop; never returns an invalid spec)
await app.compose.compose({ prompt: "narrate a greeting", emit: "build" }); // { spec, text, costUsd }

// CLI (also the `moku` bin): new | validate | estimate | run | status | compose
const code = await app.cli.dispatch(["run", "--dry-run"]);                  // exit-code contract 0..5

// Custom provider plugin (Layer 3)
const handler: Voiceover.VoiceoverHandler = {
  estimate: r => ({ usd: r.text.length * 0.00003 }),
  execute: async r => ({ audio: new Uint8Array(), mimeType: "audio/mpeg", costUsd: 0 })
};
const myProvider = createPlugin("myProvider", {
  depends: [registryPlugin],
  onInit: ctx => ctx.require(registryPlugin).register("voiceover", "acme", handler)
});

// TS build file
export default defineBuild({ version: 1, name: "demo", items: [
  { task: "voiceover", input: { text: "Hello!", voice: "en-US-1" } }
] });

await app.stop();
```

Handler protocol every registered (task, provider) handler satisfies (runner-guarded):
```ts
type ExecutableHandler = {
  estimate(request: unknown): { usd: number };
  execute(request: unknown, opts: { signal?: AbortSignal }):
    Promise<{ body: Uint8Array; mimeType: string; costUsd: number }>;
};
```

Build file format (zod-validated; BuildSpec/BuildItem are z.infer of the schema):
```yaml
version: 1              # literal 1, required
name: "launch-assets"   # required
defaults: { provider: elevenlabs, maxAttempts: 3 }   # optional
items:                  # required (may be [])
  - task: voiceover     # open set: voiceover | translate | prompt-gen | any registered
    id: intro           # optional human label
    provider: openai    # optional override (else defaults.provider, else first registered)
    input: { text: "Hello!", voice: "en-US-1" }       # required, task-specific
    params: { }         # optional, part of the planning key
    pack: { name: narration, version: "1.0.0" }       # optional
itemsFrom: extra.ndjson # optional NDJSON, one BuildItem per line, appended at compile
```

CLI exit codes: 0 ok · 1 failure · 2 validation · 3 usage · 4 paused · 5 budget stop.
Env vars: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY (configurable via each plugin's apiKeyEnv;
needed only at execute time — estimates/validation are key-free). NO_COLOR → plain CLI.

## File Structure

```
src/
  config.ts               # Layer 1: createCoreConfig("ai") + core plugins; exports createPlugin/createCore
  index.ts                # Layer 2: framework assembly; exports createApp, createPlugin, defineBuild, plugins, type namespaces
  bin.ts                  # `moku` bin — Layer-3 consumer: createApp → start → cli.dispatch → stop → exit
  plugins/
    index.ts              # barrel: plugin instances + type namespaces (Journal, Store, Limits, Buildfile, Runner, Voiceover, Translate, PromptGen, Elevenlabs, Openai, Compose, Cli)
    journal/              # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, state.ts, schema.ts, driver/ (bun:sqlite | better-sqlite3)
    store/                # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, state.ts
    limits/               # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, state.ts
    registry/             # index.ts only (Nano — no types.ts, by design)
    buildfile/            # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, schema.ts (zod), define.ts (defineBuild)
    runner/               # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, pipeline/plan/retry/stream modules
    voiceover/            # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, contract.ts, packs/
    translate/            # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, contract.ts
    promptGen/            # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, contract.ts
    elevenlabs/           # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, client.ts, prices.ts, state.ts, voiceover/handler.ts
    openai/               # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, client.ts, prices.ts, state.ts, tts/ translate/ prompt-gen/ handlers
    compose/              # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, emit.ts
    cli/                  # index.ts, types.ts, api.ts, render.ts, commands/
    <name>/__tests__/     # colocated unit/ + integration/ per plugin
tests/                    # framework-level unit/ + integration/ only
```

Package exports: `@moku-labs/ai` (ESM + CJS, types included). Bin: `moku`.
Runtime deps: @moku-labs/common, @moku-labs/core, better-sqlite3, openai, yaml, zod.

## Plugins

Core (registered in createCoreConfig; no events, no depends; injected as ctx.*):
- journal: SQLite WAL run/item/attempt ledger + atomic budget/dedup gate | Complex | openRun, getRun, latestResumableRun, insertItems, requeueDispatching, gateToDispatching, recordAttempt, finishAttempt, commitDone, markFailed, markFlagged, setRunStatus, totals, listItems, readSnapshot, checkpoint | events: none
- store: content-addressed artifact store (never lose a byte, never serve a wrong one) | Standard | put, has, pathOf, read, hashOf, gc | events: none
- limits: per-lane token bucket + FIFO concurrency + circuit breaker (timer-free lazy math) | Standard | acquire, reportOutcome, laneConfig, snapshot, lanes | events: none

Regular (in registration/dependency order; APIs on app.<name>):
- registry: dumb task→provider→handler map; handlers transported as unknown | Nano | register, resolve, providers, tasks | events: none
- buildfile: YAML + defineBuild() → validated BuildSpec IR via one zod schema; stateless pure compiler, works offline | Standard | compile, loadGlob, jsonSchema, template (+ standalone defineBuild) | events: none
- runner (deps: registry, buildfile): the durable orchestrator — plan → admit → gate → execute → persist → report; owns resume, budget stop, clean pause, retry taxonomy | Complex | run, resume, estimate, status, events | events: run:progress, run:done, run:failed, run:budget-stop, run:paused
- voiceover (deps: registry): owns "voiceover" contract (VoiceoverRequest/Result/Handler) + one-off facade; merges template-pack params | Standard | generate, estimate, providers | events: none
- translate (deps: registry): owns "translate" contract + one-off facade | Standard | generate, estimate, providers | events: none
- promptGen (deps: registry): owns "prompt-gen" contract + one-off facade (API name camelCase promptGen; task key kebab "prompt-gen"); backs compose | Standard | generate, estimate, providers | events: none
- elevenlabs (deps: registry): ElevenLabs provider — registers ("voiceover","elevenlabs"); fetch client (no SDK), per-character price table, RetryableProviderError/TerminalProviderError/FlaggedProviderError | Complex | info | events: none
- openai (deps: registry): OpenAI provider — registers ("voiceover","openai"), ("translate","openai"), ("prompt-gen","openai") via official SDK (lazy client, SDK retries disabled); token/char pricing; same error taxonomy | Complex | info | events: none
- compose (deps: buildfile, promptGen): natural language → validated build file; system prompt embeds jsonSchema(); repair loop bounded by maxRepairAttempts; emits YAML or defineBuild() script; never writes files | Standard | compose | events: none
- cli (deps: runner, buildfile, compose): the `moku` command surface (new, validate, estimate, run, status, compose); branded rendering via @moku-labs/common/cli; no lifecycle; dispatch never calls process.exit | Complex | dispatch, commands (+ EXIT_CODES) | events: none

Config defaults (per plugin, override regular plugins via createApp pluginConfigs):
- journal: path=".moku/journal.db", checkpointIntervalMs=30000, busyTimeoutMs=5000
- store: dir=".moku/store", algo="sha256"
- limits: defaults={rpm:60, concurrency:4, breakerThreshold:5, breakerCooldownMs:30000}, lanes={}
- buildfile: defaultGlob="**/*.moku.yaml", schemaPath=".moku/build.schema.json"
- runner: maxAttempts=3, retryBaseMs=1000, eventBufferSize=10000
- voiceover: defaultProvider="elevenlabs", defaultFormat="mp3"
- translate: defaultProvider="openai"
- promptGen: defaultProvider="openai"
- elevenlabs: apiKeyEnv="ELEVENLABS_API_KEY", baseUrl="https://api.elevenlabs.io", defaultModel="eleven_multilingual_v2", timeoutMs=60000, priceOverrides={}
- openai: apiKeyEnv="OPENAI_API_KEY", baseUrl=undefined, models={tts:"gpt-4o-mini-tts", chat:"gpt-4o-mini"}, timeoutMs=60000, priceOverrides={}
- compose: provider="openai", maxRepairAttempts=2
- cli: plain=false

See llms-full.txt for verbatim TypeScript interfaces, the complete event catalog,
error-handling patterns, and extension recipes. Per-plugin READMEs live at
src/plugins/<name>/README.md.
